title: AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator
description: Comprehensive preparation for the AZ-104 certification exam. Covers managing Azure identities and governance, implementing and managing storage, deploying and managing Azure compute resources, configuring and managing virtual networking, and monitoring and maintaining Azure resources.

modules.title: Manage Azure Identities and Governance
modules.description: Covers Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) users, groups, and administrative units; role-based access control (RBAC); subscriptions and governance with Azure Policy, resource locks, and management groups. Approximately 15–20% of the exam.

modules.title: Implement and Manage Storage
modules.description: Covers configuring Azure Storage accounts, blob storage, access tiers, lifecycle management, Azure Files, Azure File Sync, and storage security with SAS tokens, access keys, and Microsoft Entra authorization. Approximately 15–20% of the exam.

modules.title: Deploy and Manage Azure Compute Resources
modules.description: Covers creating and configuring VMs, availability sets, scale sets, Azure App Service plans and web apps, Azure Container Instances, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Approximately 20–25% of the exam.

modules.title: Configure and Manage Virtual Networking
modules.description: Covers virtual networks, subnets, peering, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure DNS, Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, and network routing including UDRs and service endpoints. Approximately 20–25% of the exam.

modules.title: Monitor and Maintain Azure Resources
modules.description: Covers Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, action groups, Azure Backup, Recovery Services vaults, and Azure Site Recovery. Also includes monitoring costs, interpreting metrics, and configuring diagnostic settings. Approximately 10–15% of the exam.
